reason: My POS company already runs my orders and payments, and I trust them. A new start-up with no restaurants live yet asking me to add a second system at my tables is a risk I would rather not take right now.
objection: Setting it up and training staff takes time I don't have, and I would still be ringing everything up on my POS anyway, so I would be paying to do the work twice.
would_change_my_mind: A proven live pilot in a sit-down restaurant like mine, with the QR orders flowing into my POS without double entry, and my regulars over 45 actually ordering on their phones.
